_about: A PLACE HAS TRAITS (rule 71, Paolo 10/4: 'settlements have traits too, depending on random variables'). Battle Brothers' settlement situations, in our skin. RUN TWO rolls them from this file per place (seeded by the place's name and the week, so a trait comes and goes); each one changes the PICTURE (look), the SHOPS' prices and stock, WHO stands at the posts, and what the KEEPERS say. Numbers are Battle Brothers-shaped and marked for TUNING; words are draft:true. COMBAT TWO draws the real picture variants later (burnt, boarded, flooded, market day): when a 'variant' name is set here and that picture exists, it is drawn instead of the overlay. AMENDED 10/18 (RUN TWO [the raid is a record], ECONOMY day 70): a trait with caused_by 'ledger' is NEVER rolled; it stands only when FACTIONS' raid ledger (engine/bohemia_arrivaltraits.js) marks the place on the map's day, and its numbers are that ledger file's (records/target/bb/arrival_traits.json, the wiki's cards), so this file carries only its look and its words.

relation_prices._about: RUN TWO [the sell price by the bar] 10/18: the wiki's Market prices page, verbatim: 'increasing Relations from 50 to 100 will improve selling price modifiers... from 17.69% to 19.69%' (about 2% of worth, added) and 'the maximum decrease is about 15% of worth for buying price modifiers... factored in additively'; situations multiply after relations. Below 50 the page says nothing, so nothing moves below Neutral (TUNING's when it rules).
relation_prices.source: reference/library/grok/wiki/PAGES_ALL.tar.gz bb_all/1244_Market prices for various items.txt (section 3, Settlement relations)

traits.name: RAIDED
traits.numbers: records/target/bb/arrival_traits.json traits.raided (the wiki's Raided card, page 1626: -50% items, -50% recruits, no price); the screen reads them there, stock_mult here only thins the map's crowd (engine/bohemia_livingmap.js crowdOf)

says.any: A crew came through three nights back. Burned the Ortega house. Half of what we had walked out with them, mijo.
says.lot: Burned out. Whatever was worth taking here walked off with them.
says.hall: Half the block left after the raid. The ones still here want work.
says.smith: Everybody wants a blade fixed since the raid. I am three deep already.
says.armourer: Half my stock walked out the door with the crew that hit us. Same price on what is left.
says.barber: Nobody wants a new face right now. They want their old one back.
says.clinic: Three of mine from the raid are still on the cots. I am not taking anyone new today.
says.board: Since the raid, half the block wants to leave. The rest will work if it pays.

traits.name: SICKNESS
traits.numbers: the wiki's Sickness card (page 1792, the library's own copy): +100% food prices, medicine buying +200%, recruits -25%, nothing else (ECONOMY day 71: ours had raised every price; its 'the card's only price is MEDICINE' missed the food line the page prints first, RUN TWO [the clinic's cough] 10/18). The clinic's treatment is the wiki's temple formula on the settlement's prices multiplier, which the card does not move, so the clinic keeper treats at the usual price and says so

says.any: Half the block is coughing. They boarded up the clinic windows to keep it in.
says.lot: Nobody out here today. Sick, or scared of it. More for me.
says.hall: Fewer signing on with the cough going around. The ones here are not coughing, I checked.
says.smith: Keep your hands off my tools if you have been near the clinic.
says.armourer: I am not touching a man's armour until the cough clears. Bad luck, same as bad metal.
says.barber: No cuts while the cough is going around. I am not catching it off your collar.
says.clinic: Half the block is on my cots, coughing. Yours still come first if you can pay, same price as always, mijo.
says.board: Nobody wants a job that takes them near the sick houses. I do not blame them.

traits.name: MARKET DAY
traits.numbers: the wiki's Seasonal Fair card (page 1744): +25% buying, +25% selling, +25% items, +25% recruits (ECONOMY day 71: there is no Celebration situation, and ours ran the fair backwards, cheaper)

says.any: Market day. Everybody is out, everything is moving. Good day to sell, bad day to buy.
says.lot: Everybody's at the market. Nobody's watching the lot.
says.hall: Lot of new faces in town today. Some of them want work.
says.smith: Everybody wants a blade sharp for market day. Busy, but good busy.
says.armourer: Sold three pieces before noon at market prices. Market day does that.
says.barber: Everybody wants to look good for market day. Sit, sit, there is a line.
says.clinic: Quiet today. Even the sick ones are out at the market.
says.board: New faces in town for market day. A few of them want work.

traits.name: TAKEN
traits.numbers: records/target/bb/arrival_traits.json traits.conquered (the wiki's Conquered card, page 0437)

says.any: New people run this block now. They take their cut off every sale, so you pay more and get less.
says.lot: New people run this block. I keep my head down and look anyway.
says.smith: The new bosses take a piece of every blade I sell. Do not look at me like that.
says.hall: Some of the old crew want out from under the new bosses. Look them over.

traits.name: WELL SUPPLIED
traits.numbers: records/target/bb/arrival_traits.json traits.well_supplied (the wiki's Well Supplied card, page 2199)

says.any: A convoy made it in. The shelves are full and nobody is fighting over the price.
says.lot: Full shelves in town. Less out here worth digging for.
says.smith: Fresh steel off the convoy. I can let it go cheaper this week.

traits.name: REFUGEES
traits.numbers: the wiki's Refugees card (page 1660): -25% food available, +25% food prices, -10% items, 'Refugees are more likely to be available for hire' (no number on the card, so the posts' count and price do not move: TUNING's table when it has one). It stands, never rolled, while FACTIONS' raid ledger marks RAIDED on the place NEAREST this one on the map (records/target/BOHEMIA_BAR_NEWS_PLACES.json, the map's own seats and cells), on the same days (RUN TWO [the neighbour takes the refugees]; ECONOMY day 70: 'the raided town is not dearer, it is EMPTY... the dear town is the one NEXT to it, where the people went')

says.any: These are people from {from}, mijo. The {by} burned them out {ago} and now they sleep in our lot.
says.lot: People sleeping in the rubble. I take what they leave.
says.board: We have half of {from} sleeping in our lot since the {by} hit them {ago}. Be patient with us, mijo.
says.hall: Half the ones at the posts walked here from {from} after the {by} hit it. They will work for food, pues.
says.stall: Food goes fast with all the people from {from} here. It costs more this week, ni modo.
says.bar: The bar is full of people from {from}, drinking on credit. The {by} took everything they had.
says.clinic: Burns and cut feet, all of them from {from}. The {by} did not leave much.
says.smith: Men from {from} keep asking me for a blade to go back with. They have nothing to pay, carnal.
says.armourer: Half my stock went to people from {from} who want to go back and fight the {by}.
says.barber: Nobody from {from} wants a haircut, mijo. They want a place to sleep.
